summary: This bill renames the federal holiday observed on the third Monday in February from "Washington's Birthday" to "Presidents' Day" in all federal laws, rules, regulations, and official papers.

scores.thoughts: This bill renames a federal holiday but does not introduce any new spending or cut existing spending. The administrative costs of updating official documents would be negligible and not central to the bill's purpose.

The bill makes a conforming amendment to the Federal Contested Election Act by changing 'Washington's Birthday' to 'Presidents' Day' within its text. This is purely a linguistic update and has no impact on voting access, election reform, or election security.
